backend/main.mo: Motoko backend providing access‑controlled user profiles and product CRUD operations with public read queries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries mapping frontend file paths to short descriptions of their functionality.
frontend/docs/custom-domain-luxeoushub.c: Documentation detailing DNS setup, platform configuration, and troubleshooting for configuring the luxeoushub.com custom domain.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS layer defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode variables, and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, and mounting root for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Simple router component switching between HomePage and SellerDashboardPage using local state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button wired to Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Minimal footer showing Luxeoushub copyright with the current year.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Affil: Affiliate disclosure section explaining Amazon Associates participation and commission details.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Produ: Card component showing product image, title, optional badge, and secure Amazon purchase link.
Section component rendering a product grid with loading skeletons and empty-state handling.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Trust: Displays three trust badges highlighting delivery speed, product reliability, and customer support information.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendHealth.ts: Checks backend health status using the actor and exposes success or unreachable states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines product-fetching hooks for all products, by section, and by ID using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSellerProducts.ts: Implements seller‑specific queries and mutations for roles and product management using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStorefrontSections: Fetches all products and provides a helper to filter them by section tags for storefront display.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the storefront homepage with navigation, product sections, health checks, and a link to the seller dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/SellerDashboardPage.t: Implements the seller dashboard with auth checks, product CRUD forms, section tag management, and UI for adding, editing, and deleting products. Uses React hooks and mutations to load and modify seller-specific products.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL params (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them, enabling state retention across navigation. Includes utilities for safely removing sensitive params from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, shadows, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations. Extends theme settings used across the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Stores the app’s project state, including feature list, requirements, known issues, and architectural notes for the Luxeoushub storefront build. Used as structured metadata for planning and tracking implementation status.
